brief.audience: People who want to get back into running and build a lasting routine.
brief.goal: Encourage people to try the app.

creatives.hook: What if getting started is the hardest part? Meet Runclub.
creatives.script:
Audience: People who want to get back into running and build a lasting routine.
Goal: Encourage people to try the app.
Tone to aim for: Clear and friendly

0–3 s · Open with an everyday moment your audience recognizes.
3–12 s · Open Runclub and show: Gradual training plans.
12–20 s · Show one action from start to finish using real screen footage.
20–25 s · Close with the first small step someone can take in the app.

Shot list: a familiar situation, a screen recording, a closing piece to camera.
creatives.cta: Discover Runclub and take your first step.

creatives.hook: Here is what you can actually do with Runclub.
creatives.script:
Audience: People who want to get back into running and build a lasting routine.
Goal: Encourage people to try the app.
Tone to aim for: Clear and friendly

0–3 s · Preview the result you will demonstrate, without invented stats.
3–10 s · Show how to get started with Gradual training plans.
10–18 s · Move on to Challenges with friends and explain why it helps.
18–25 s · Return to the result and give viewers a moment to take it in.

Shot list: a continuous app recording, a voiceover and captions.
creatives.cta: Try it for yourself with Runclub.

creatives.hook: Why build Runclub? It started with a simple need.
creatives.script:
Audience: People who want to get back into running and build a lasting routine.
Goal: Encourage people to try the app.
Tone to aim for: Clear and friendly

0–4 s · The creator describes a problem they actually experienced.
4–12 s · Connect that need to Gradual training plans, using a specific example.
12–20 s · Show Runclub in use and explain a design choice or a limitation.
20–30 s · Invite viewers to try it and share their feedback.

Shot list: a piece to camera, an app recording and a behind-the-scenes detail. Do not present an actor as a real customer.
creatives.cta: Try Runclub and tell us what you think.
